notes.title: Patch v 1.4
notes.content:
[u][b]Build id: 4199503[/b][/u]


[h1]Balance & AI Tweaks[/h1]

[list]
[*] Enemies now have a particle effect when attack.
[*] Enemy health has been reduced , players will find it easier to handle big groups now.
[*] Enemy attack behaviour has been tweaked.
[*] A varying amount of knock has been added to Raakh's melee attacks
[*] Raakh has new animation when he gets interrupted by an enemy attack.
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Shukracharya becoming invulnerable at low health in Mahakali Temple has been fixed.
[/list]

Please let us know if you encounter any other issues in the Bug Report section of the community hub.

Vanishing Point Game Studios

notes.title: Patch v 1.3
notes.content:
[u][b]Build id: 4118601[/b][/u]

[h1]Combat Change[/h1]
We have reworked the combat of the game, players will find executing combos with much ease. Hopefully making it more fun and enjoyable.


[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

[list]

[*] Health and mana value at the end of Shivalik is fixed to restore the proper amount
[*]Health and mana orbs  have been added in certain levels to ensure the player isn't stuck in and infinite death loop with low health.
[*]Navratan Islands has been changed where in the player will now have to collect orbs before proceeding to the next island. 
[*]Navratan island combat music bug fixed.
[*]Certain enemy seals have been moved and adjusted so that the player doesnt get stuck outside of the combat encounter
[*] Pushpak Viman enemy spawn mesh is no longer destructible.

[/list]
Please let us know if you encounter any other issues in the Bug Report section of the community hub.

Vanishing Point Game Studios
